pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction of concatenated cross-session two-photon GCaMP6f imaging data using Suite2p's rigid motion-correction strategy

parameters.concatenation: all imaging sessions for a given field of view concatenated before correction

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, cross-session-concatenated time-series

pipeline_steps.technique: Manual ROI selection over putative CA1 pyramidal cell somata on the cross-session GCaMP6f time-average image, with post hoc tagging of Robo2 knockout cells via the mCherry channel

parameters.roi_drawing_reference: cross-session GCaMP6f-channel time-average image only; red (mCherry) channel withheld during drawing to avoid bias
parameters.ko_cell_tagging: ROIs cross-referenced against the mCherry channel only after all ROIs were drawn; when red wasn't recorded simultaneously, an affine-transformed red-only reference image acquired just prior to imaging was used instead

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: hand-drawn ROI set with KO/WT cell identity tags

pipeline_steps.technique: Extraction of dynamic GCaMP6f fluorescence signals from ROIs for each imaging session using SIMA

parameters.quality_control: one session with dropped data during the final >1 minute of recording was excluded from analysis

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-ROI, per-session raw fluorescence time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Deconvolution of fluorescence traces into spike trains using OASIS under an AR1 model, with a custom baseline-subtraction and adaptive noise-threshold procedure

parameters.baseline_estimation: Gaussian-smoothed trace (std=5 frames, window=30s), then rolling minimum (window=30s), then rolling maximum (window=30s)
parameters.deconvolution_model: AR1 with penalty, decay parameter fixed to 400 ms GCaMP6f decay time
parameters.noise_threshold: median + 1.5x median absolute deviation (MAD) of the baseline-subtracted trace at putative noise-only (no-spike) timepoints
parameters.final_pass: spike train recomputed with minimum spike size set to the noise threshold and sparsity parameter set to 3

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: deconvolved spike trains per ROI per session

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning analysis and place-field identification via a shuffled null distribution, restricted to running-defined epochs

parameters.running_epoch_definition: consecutive frames of forward locomotion >=1 s duration with peak speed >=5 cm/s; epochs separated by <0.5 s merged
parameters.null_distribution: position vector cyclically permuted by a random offset and tuning vector recomputed; repeated 1000 times
parameters.tuning_vector_smoothing: Gaussian (std=3 position bins), applied to both true and null tuning vectors
parameters.place_field_criterion: at least 5 consecutive position bins above the 95th percentile of the null distribution, with the cell firing on at least 15% of laps

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: deconvolved spike trains aligned to position/running signal
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning vectors and place-field calls per cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Statistical testing of imaging-derived metrics using the field of view, not individual cells, as the unit of analysis

parameters.unit_of_analysis: field of view (FOV); metrics aggregated across all cells and sessions per FOV
parameters.paired_comparisons: paired Student's t-test, n-1 degrees of freedom
parameters.decoding_analysis_test: repeated-measures two-way ANOVA with interaction, testing subpopulation means across surrogate population sizes

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection into dorsal CA1 followed by headpost and chronic imaging-window implantation

parameters.virus_delivery: 50 nL (10 nL pulses) of rAAV at three DV locations via Nanoject syringe
parameters.coordinates: -2.1 mm AP; -1.5 mm ML; -0.9/-1.05/-1.2 mm DV relative to Bregma
parameters.headpost: custom metal headpost (stainless steel or titanium)
parameters.imaging_window: 3.0 mm diameter, 1.5-2.3 mm height steel cannula with 3 mm glass coverslip (Warner 64-0720), bonded with Narland optical adhesive
parameters.craniotomy: 3 mm hole; dura and cortical layers removed under visual guidance with ice-cold cortex buffer irrigation
parameters.postop_care: monitoring and meloxicam analgesia for 3 days

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo single-cell electroporation of plasmid DNA into individual CA1 pyramidal cells through the imaging cannula

parameters.cannula_variant: custom 316L stainless steel cannula (InterPRO), 1.9 mm height x 3.0 mm diameter, angled side with a 0.15x0.35 mm pipette-access opening sealed with a 0.02 mm silicone layer (J-B Weld)
parameters.plasmids: pCAGGS-GCaMP7b and pCAGGS-ChRmine-mScarlet, each at 50 ng/uL
parameters.electroporation_solution: 155 mM K-gluconate, 10 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM KOH (pH 7.3, 316 mOsm) plus 0.33 mM Alexa Fluor 488
parameters.pipette: long-taper borosilicate (Warner G200-3) pulled with a Zeitz DMZ puller, tip resistance 2.5-6 MOhm
parameters.stimulation: 1 s, 100 Hz, 0.5 ms, 5 V pulse train via an A.M.P.I. ISO-Flex stimulus isolator, generated in Clampex 10.7 through a Digidata 1550B and a Dagan BVC-700A amplifier
parameters.targeting_depth: ~150 um below brain surface, pipette at a 32-degree angle
parameters.throughput: 3-5 neurons electroporated per mouse per session; ~30-40% expression success confirmed 1-2 days later

pipeline_steps.hardware: Dagan BVC-700A amplifier; Digidata 1550B; A.M.P.I. ISO-Flex stimulus isolator

pipeline_steps.technique: Combinatorial Cre/Flp-dependent viral construct strategy for opsin, indicator, and DREADD expression across cell types

parameters.opsins: Cre-dependent ChRmine (AAV8 or AAV2/1.Ef1a.DIO.ChRmine.oScarlet.WPRE) for CA1 pyramidal cells; Cre-ON/Flp-OFF ChRmine (AAV8.nEF.Con/Foff.2.0) in VGAT-Flp mice to avoid direct interneuron stimulation; Cre-dependent bReaChES (AAV2/9.Ef1a.FLEX.Breaches.tdTomato)
parameters.inhibition_suppression_constructs: GiDREADD (AAV2/1.h56D.HA-hM4D(Gi).mCherry) or FlpO with Flp-dependent tdTomato, or Flp-ON/Cre-OFF Arch3.3-eYFP, under the h56D GABAergic-selective promoter
parameters.induction: tamoxifen-inducible Cre under the CaMKIIa promoter (AAV2/1.CaMKII.Cre.ERT2); 125 uL of 5 mg/mL tamoxifen or 4-hydroxytamoxifen, i.p., at least 48 h before experiments

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed treadmill training and goal-oriented/place-field-induction behavioral paradigms

parameters.treadmill: 1.94 m belt with water delivery port, lick sensor, and custom electronics for position/licking
parameters.initial_training: cue-deficient burlap belt, non-operant reward, progressively restrictive schedule from 12-15 down to 1 reward zone per lap over 1-2 weeks
parameters.induction_protocol: 15 min baseline, >15 min break, 20 min induction session (photostimulation on a fixed stimulation zone for 5 consecutive laps after lap 1), 15 min follow-up sessions at 24 h intervals up to 72 h
parameters.goal_oriented_learning: 10 cm hidden reward zone at least 10 cm from the nearest tactile cue; up to 2 sessions/day for 4 days, reward zone moved every 24 h
parameters.hygiene_control: belts cleaned with 70% ethanol between sessions

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: position, licking, and reward-event traces synchronized to imaging

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging acquisition through the chronic CA1 window

parameters.objective: 40x NIR water immersion (Nikon, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD) for SCE/2p-stimulation experiments; 16x NIR (0.8 NA, 3.0 mm WD) for LED-stimulation/control experiments
parameters.laser: 920 nm, 50-100 mW at objective back aperture (Coherent), power regulated by a Pockels cell (Conoptics)
parameters.detectors: GaAsP (Hamamatsu 7422P-40) and Multi-Alkali (Hamamatsu R3896) PMTs; green/red split via HQ525/70m-2p and HQ607/45m-2p filters with a 575dcxr dichroic
parameters.acquisition_params: 1-2x digital zoom, ~166-330 um (40x) or ~550-880 um (16x) field of view, 512x512 px at 30 Hz

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon fluorescence time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Widefield LED optogenetic photostimulation integrated with the two-photon imaging path

parameters.led: UHP-T-620-SR (Prizmatix), ultrafast high-power collimated red LED with a 629/56 nm excitation cleanup filter (Semrock)
parameters.beam_combining: 775 nm shortpass dichroic (ZT775sp-2p) and 561 nm longpass dichroic (Di02-R561-25x36)
parameters.timing: LED gated by the imaging Pockels-cell blanking signal, pulsed during galvanometer flyback between frames (~30 Hz)
parameters.power: ~30 mW after the objective (~54 mW/mm^2 before the coverglass)
parameters.protocol: 1 s pulse on stimulation-zone entry for 5 consecutive laps (induction), or every 20-24 s at random times (random-stimulation experiments)

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-photon targeted (spiral-scan) optogenetic photostimulation of individually selected or densely labeled CA1 cell ensembles

parameters.system: dual scan-head microscope (Ultima, Bruker): resonant-galvo pair for imaging, galvo-galvo pair for photostimulation
parameters.laser: 1040 nm femtosecond fiber laser (FidelityHP, Coherent; 140 fs pulses, 80 MHz repetition rate)
parameters.cell_targeting: pre-selected by visual confirmation of opsin-reporter expression and functional light response on a separate uncued training belt
parameters.scan_pattern: ~1 s spiral scan, 15-20 um outer diameter, 15 rotations per spiral, repeated 31 times
parameters.power: typically 80 mW after the objective at >250 um depth (range 60-120 mW)

pipeline_steps.hardware: Ultima dual scan-head microscope (Bruker); FidelityHP fiber laser (Coherent)

pipeline_steps.technique: Chemogenetic suppression of CA1 interneuron activity via CNO activation of virally delivered GiDREADD

parameters.construct: GiDREADD (hM4D(Gi)) delivered virally to CA1 interneurons
parameters.drug: 10 mg/kg CNO in saline (Cayman Chemical), i.p., or saline control, 20-30 min before the baseline session

pipeline_steps.technique: Bilateral optical fiber implantation and optogenetic manipulation of CA1 during the goal-oriented learning task

parameters.virus_mixture: tamoxifen-inducible Cre, Cre-dependent ChRmine, h56D-FlpO, and Flp-ON/Cre-OFF Arch (or Flp-dependent tdTomato in ChRmine-only controls)
parameters.injection: 64 nL per site, bilateral, at +/-2.1/+/-1.4, +/-2.3/+/-1.5, +/-2.6/+/-1.5 mm AP/ML with -0.9/-1.05/-1.2 mm DV relative to Bregma
parameters.implant: bilateral optical fiber cannulae (200 um core, 0.37 NA) plus stainless-steel headpost
parameters.stimulation: 532 nm laser (50 mW, OptoEngine) via a splitter patch cable, 1 s of 30 Hz bilateral stimulation (20 mW) on laps 6-10 of session 2, at a stimulation zone at least 400 cm from the reward zone

pipeline_steps.technique: Image preprocessing: motion correction, ROI/signal generation, and manual curation

parameters.motion_correction: Suite2p rigid motion correction, all sessions per FOV concatenated
parameters.roi_generation: Suite2p ROI/signal generation with neuropil correction
parameters.curation: manual curation via GUI to exclude non-somatic components

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, neuropil-corrected ROI fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Signal processing and event detection via adaptive-threshold OASIS deconvolution

parameters.detrending: linear detrend; negative outliers >3 MAD below median replaced with median
parameters.baseline: Gaussian filter (std=5 frames, 30 s window), rolling min then rolling max (30 s windows)
parameters.deconvolution: OASIS, AR1 model, L1 penalty, decay 400 ms (GCaMP6f) or 2 s (GCaMP6s)
parameters.adaptive_threshold: noise threshold = median + 3 MAD of no-spike baseline periods, used as explicit minimum spike size with sparsity lambda=7

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: deconvolved spike trains

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning analysis and place-field detection via shuffled null distribution

parameters.smoothing: Gaussian, sigma=1 frame (spikes), sigma=3 position bins (tuning vector)
parameters.shuffle_test: 1000 cyclic permutations of position vector, 95th percentile threshold
parameters.place_field_criteria: >=5 consecutive significant bins, active on >=15% of laps, edges extended to half-peak, overlapping fields merged

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning vectors and detected place fields

pipeline_steps.technique: Stimulated-cell detection via significance, reliability, and magnitude criteria on peri-stimulation fluorescence

parameters.windows: 1 s pre-stim, 0.5 s post-stim, averaged across 5 stimulations
parameters.significance: post-minus-pre PSTH change vs. 1000 null draws of non-overlapping frames, 95th percentile threshold
parameters.reliability: z-scored post-stim fluorescence >=1 SD above pre-stim for >=3 of 5 stimulations
parameters.magnitude: post-stim PSTH mean >1.5 SD above baseline
parameters.spatial_criterion: targeted stimulation only: within 75 um of stimulation radius
parameters.exclusion: cells with a pre-existing place field overlapping the stimulation zone excluded (applied symmetrically to unstimulated cells)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified stimulated vs. unstimulated cells

pipeline_steps.technique: Template-based remapping analysis comparing pre- and post-stimulation spatial tuning

parameters.templates: mean tuning vector over last 10 PRE laps and first 10 (of laps 6-15) POST laps
parameters.score: difference between mean per-lap Pearson correlation to pre- vs. post-stimulation template
parameters.inclusion: trial-to-trial spatial reliability r>0.25 with the relevant template

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell remapping score

pipeline_steps.technique: Offline pairwise reactivation correlation analysis relating place-field-peak distance to immobility-period fluorescence correlation

parameters.comparison: place-field peak distance vs. Pearson correlation of baselined fluorescence, per cell pair

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: detected place fields and baselined fluorescence traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: pairwise reactivation correlation vs. place-field distance relationship

pipeline_steps.technique: Development of the two-photon-guided single-cell electroporation protocol for starter-cell plasmid delivery (TVA-HA, rabies glycoprotein, GCaMP7s, opsin, Cre-mRuby)

parameters.pulse: single pulse train, -5 V, 100 Hz, 0.5 ms pulse width, 1 s duration

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: electroporated starter CA1 pyramidal cell protocol
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Two-photon guided electroporation was adapted from previously

pipeline_steps.technique: Development of the optogenetic place-field induction protocol (targeted illumination of the starter cell during running)

parameters.light: 625-nm LED, 35-70 mW under objective, Arduino-gated Pockels cell, 1-1.5 s pulse over 4-6 laps

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: induced place field at a randomly chosen belt location
pipeline_steps.source_quote: a pulse of light of 1-1.5 s duration was delivered

pipeline_steps.technique: In utero electroporation targeting hippocampal CA1 pyramidal-neuron progenitors with Cre and FLEX-tdTomato/mCherry plasmids

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sparsely labeled CA1 pyramidal neurons for dendritic tracing
pipeline_steps.source_quote: In utero electroporation targeting the hippocampus was performed

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: GCaMP6f-expressing CA1 pyramidal neurons
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Viral delivery to hippocampal area CA1 was done as described

pipeline_steps.technique: Imaging window and contralateral silicon-probe/electrode implantation over dorsal CA1

parameters.probe: single-shank 4-channel linear silicon probe (Q-trode, Neuronexus), 45° angle

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic imaging window with contralateral LFP electrode
pipeline_steps.source_quote: surgically implanted with an imaging window

pipeline_steps.technique: Random Foraging and Goal-Oriented Learning treadmill behavioral paradigms with water reward
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: position, lick, and water-delivery behavioral data
pipeline_steps.source_quote: mice were water restricted (>90% pre-deprivation weight)

pipeline_steps.technique: Multiplane in vivo two-photon calcium imaging of CA1 dendrites and somata during behavior

parameters.planes: 3 planes at 7.2 Hz, or 7 planes at 3.5 Hz

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: multiplane dendritic/somatic calcium imaging movies
pipeline_steps.source_quote: All imaging was conducted using a 2-photon 8 kHz resonant scanning

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction and structural-functional registration for dendritic ROI generation

parameters.tracing: manual tracing of cells in structural stacks, projected onto functional planes via affine transform

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: registered dendritic and somatic ROIs
pipeline_steps.source_quote: All cells in time-averaged structural stacks were manually traced

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium signal extraction and statistically significant transient detection

pipeline_steps.source_quote: Dynamic GCaMP6f fluorescence signals were extracted for each

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning analysis and day-to-day place-field stability (centroid shift) analysis

parameters.criterion: spatial information (Danielson et al., 2016; Zaremba et al., 2017)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatially tuned ROIs, place field stability classification
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Spatially tuned ROIs were detected based on spatial information
